description: Terrain elevation from the Copernicus Digital Elevation Model (~90m resolution) for one or more coordinate pairs. Accepts up to 1,000 pairs and samples the first 100 in one upstream request; when more were submitted, unprocessed_count says how many remain and next_offset is where to resume — resubmit latitudes.slice(next_offset) and longitudes.slice(next_offset) of the arrays just sent, until next_offset is null. Open-Meteo counts each sampled pair as one call against its per-IP limit of 600 a minute, so a seventh full slice inside one minute comes back rate_limited — space later slices about a minute apart. Useful for geographic context, elevation-adjusted weather interpretation, or route planning. A point the DEM has no value for (latitude 90) returns elevation_m null; the other points in the call are unaffected.

latitudes.description: Array of latitudes in decimal degrees (up to 1,000; the first 100 are sampled per call). Must be same length as longitudes.

longitudes.description: Array of longitudes in decimal degrees (up to 1,000; the first 100 are sampled per call). Must be same length as latitudes.

name: openmeteo_get_elevation

elevations.description: Elevation values for the sampled pairs (the first 100), in input order

items.description: Elevation for a single coordinate pair

elevation_m.description: Terrain elevation in meters above sea level; null when the DEM has no value for this point

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `coordinate_count_mismatch`: The latitudes and longitudes arrays have different lengths. `rate_limited`: Open-Meteo answered HTTP 429 because a free-tier request limit was reached. `upstream_unavailable`: Open-Meteo was unreachable, answered with a server error, or returned an unreadable response on all three attempts. `upstream_timeout`: Open-Meteo failed on all three attempts, and the last one got no answer within 15 seconds. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Index to resume from: resubmit latitudes.slice(next_offset) and longitudes.slice(next_offset) of the arrays sent in this call. null when every submitted pair was sampled.

notice.description: Present only when more than 100 pairs were submitted: names how many were sampled and how many remain, and the slice of the submitted arrays to resubmit for the rest.

unprocessed_count.description: Submitted pairs that were not sampled in this call; 0 when 100 or fewer were submitted

title: Openmeteo Get Elevation
